summary: Comprehensive end-to-end scan of HeartLink completed. 15/15 backend tests passed covering auth (login/forgot/reset), admin dashboard-stats, all-users pagination, admin reset-user-password, admin block/unblock, message/swipe/profile-view endpoints, and profile GET. Frontend UI verified: home landing, /auth login+signup tabs, login → /discover navigation, /admin dashboard renders with all 7 tabs (Overview, All Users, Verifications, Approvals, Notifications, Settings, AI Girls) and live stats (17 users, 19 matches, 55 messages, 10 verified), and /forgot-password → send code → code entry step works end-to-end. Admin credentials (review@heartlink.co.in / HeartLink@2026) work.

minor.issue: Review request references these paths but actual routes are /api/messages (POST) and /api/action/{user_id}. Endpoints exist under real names; not a bug, just naming clarification for docs/frontend consumers.

issues: OneSignal web-push init error 'App not configured for web push' logged on every page load. Harmless on web since app targets Capacitor/Android, but consider gating OneSignal.init() to Capacitor.isNativePlatform() to silence errors in web preview.

action_items: Optional: gate OneSignal web init to native platform to avoid console errors in web/preview.
Optional: add convenience aliases /api/messages/send and /api/actions/swipe (or update client/docs to use existing /api/messages and /api/action/{user_id}).
critical_code_review_comments: server.py is 7349 lines - should be split into routers (auth, admin, messages, matching, discovery) for maintainability.
Login endpoint correctly uses field name 'email_or_phone' and returns token+user object. is_admin flag present on user.
/api/admin/all-users returns paginated {users:[...]} with no MongoDB _id leaks (verified via test).
Forgot-password returns success even for unknown emails (good - prevents user enumeration).
test_credentials: review@heartlink.co.in / HeartLink@2026 verified working. testmale@heartlink.co.in / Test@2026 (demo) - login not exercised in UI but present in credentials file.
context_for_next_testing_agent: Comprehensive scan complete. Reusable test suite at /app/backend/tests/test_comprehensive_scan.py. Frontend routes verified: /, /auth, /forgot-password, /discover (after login), /admin. Admin dashboard fully functional with real data. Known non-issues: OneSignal web-push errors on web preview (Capacitor native only), Capacitor PushNotifications plugin errors on web. Real device push flow can only be verified on Android build.
rca of the issue: No blocking issues found. All features (login, password reset flow, admin panel, notifications backend, message/swipe/profile-view triggers) working correctly end-to-end.
